parts.text:
Explain the ways in which the Umayyad caliphs provided religious leadership.
You should refer to Fig. 1.1 and your own knowledge in your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘The main purpose of the Umayyad caliphs was to provide religious leadership.’ Do you
agree? You should make reference to different points of view in your answer. 
OR

text: Study Fig. 1.1 which shows Umayyad constructions.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain how the ͑ Abbasid caliphs strengthened their rule.
You should refer to Fig. 2.1 and your own knowledge in your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Discuss how far the power of the ͑ Abbasid caliphs still inspires Muslims today.
You should make reference to different points of view. 
Section B
Answer EITHER Question 3 OR Question 4.
EITHER

text: Study Fig. 2.1 which shows Mahmud of Ghazni receiving a robe from the ͑ Abbasid Caliph.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain how one significant work written by a Muslim that you have studied might be used to
invite people to Islam.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘It is more effective to use different sources for different people.’
Discuss this statement with regard to ways in which Muslims might explain to others their
main beliefs (daʿwah) today. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain the meaning of domes and geometrical patterns in Islamic architecture.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Discuss the effectiveness of Islamic architecture in portraying Muslim beliefs about God.
